issues.detail: The Greek 'μακροθυμίαν' (long-suffering/patience) is translated as 'sự nhịn nhục' (forbearance/patience), which is the same as the translation of 'ὑπομονήν' (endurance/patience). This conflates two distinct concepts, making the Vietnamese reader think both refer to the same thing, whereas the Greek distinguishes between endurance (ὑπομονήν) and long-suffering (μακροθυμίαν).
